% A \qedsymbol that the document redefines, after text and in a display's
% tag.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}
\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{$\blacksquare$}
\begin{document}
\begin{proof}[After text]
Ends in text.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[In a display]
Ends in a display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{proof}
\end{document}
